title: ServiceNow Technical Architect
description:
Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies. We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one. 
 Job summary: We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Technical Architect with 8+ years of experience in ServiceNow development, implementation, and solution architecture to lead the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and enterprise-grade ServiceNow solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong hands-on technical expertise, architecture capabilities, and experience translating complex business requirements into sustainable technical solutions across the ServiceNow platform. The role requires expertise in platform architecture, integrations, custom application development, scripting, security, and portal solutions, including Employee Center and Customer Service Management (CSM). The candidate should be comfortable leading technical discussions, guiding development teams, and engaging with senior stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Own and drive end-to-end ServiceNow technical architecture, including solution design, platform configuration, integrations, data architecture, security, and deployment strategy. Translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable ServiceNow solutions across relevant modules such as ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HRSD, ITAM, SPM, IRM/GRC, and App Engine. Define technical standards and best practices for platform development, scripting, custom applications, integrations, CMDB, and upgrade-safe configurations. Lead complex technical implementations using Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and custom application development. Design and govern enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, identity providers, cloud platforms, and external business applications. Drive Employee Center and CSM portal architecture, including portal configuration, widgets, taxonomy, navigation, search, and self-service experiences. Conduct architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, and technical discussions with clients and internal stakeholders. Identify technical risks, performance bottlenecks, platform limitations, and technical debt, recommending scalable and sustainable solutions. Provide technical leadership, code reviews, and mentorship to developers and technical consultants. Ensure adherence to ServiceNow development standards, security guidelines, performance optimization, and platform upgrade best practices. Qualifications skills: 8+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development, implementation, technical consulting, and solution architecture. Strong expertise in ServiceNow platform architecture, technical design, configuration, customization, and enterprise implementations. Proven experience designing and delivering end-to-end ServiceNow solutions across multiple product lines, with hands-on expertise in at least two or more modules such as ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HRSD, ITAM, SPM, IRM/GRC, or App Engine. Strong hands-on proficiency in JavaScript, including ServiceNow server-side and client-side scripting. Expertise in Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Service Catalog, and custom application development. Strong experience designing and implementing integrations using REST APIs, SOAP, web services, middleware, and external enterprise applications. Good understanding of CMDB, data modelling, ACLs, platform security, access controls, and enterprise data architecture. Experience with Employee Center and/or Customer Service Management (CSM) portal architecture, including portal configuration, widgets, taxonomy, navigation, search, and self-service experiences. Strong understanding of ServiceNow Service Portal, widget configuration, customization, reusable components, and portal performance optimization. Ability to evaluate out-of-the-box capabilities versus custom development and design scalable, secure, and upgrade-safe solutions. Experience with application deployment, update sets, source control, version management, and CI/CD practices. Proven ability to lead technical architecture discussions, solution design workshops, architecture reviews, and technical decision-making. Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring developers, conducting code reviews, and ensuring adherence to development and architectural standards. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, problem-solving, and performance optimization skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into practical technical solutions. Preferred Skills: Experience with enterprise-scale digital transformation and ServiceNow platform modernization initiatives. Exposure to ServiceNow AI capabilities, automation, analytics, and emerging platform technologies. Integration using REST APIs. Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments. Prior consulting or client-facing implementation experience. Certification: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA). ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD). Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in ITSM, CSM, HRSD, or other relevant modules. ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Certified Master Architect (CMA) would be a strong advantage. What We Believe In At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities. We believe part of our mission is to expand the minds, hearts, and opportunities of our Cprime teammates and within the broader community to include those who have been historically marginalized. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Cprime is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Walk-in || Solution Architect
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 21 Nov - 22 Nov
Timing: 9.30 AM - 5.30 PM
Venue: Will be shared to relevant candidates. Location of interview will be shared Individually, for in-person meeting. Exclusive meeting slot will be provided to shortlisted candidates. Please apply only if you are able to meet in 21 or 22 Nov in person.

Tech Lead / Solution Architect (Stream Lead) 
 Role: As a Tech Lead / Solution Architect (Stream Lead) , you will lead an engineering pod (stream) building features for an enterprise-grade SaaS platform in the data privacy, data governance and AI governance space. You will own the technical design of your stream within the clients architecture governance, break the backlog into deliverable work, and make sure every sprint ships production-ready, well-tested code. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines solution design, code and design reviews, and day-to-day guidance of a team of backend, data/AI, frontend and quality engineers. Key Responsibilities: Own the technical design and solution architecture for your stream, aligned with the clients architecture governance, standards and review processes. Break down epics and features into well-defined user stories and technical tasks, and provide reliable effort estimates. Lead sprint planning and execution for the pod, making sure committed scope is delivered on time and meets the definition of done. Conduct code and design reviews across backend (Java/Spring Boot, Python), frontend (Angular) and integration components, enforcing quality, security and performance standards. Design scalable microservices, REST APIs and integration patterns, including connectors to SaaS, cloud, data and AI platforms. Drive release readiness: test coverage, CI/CD quality gates, documentation & deployment sign-off. Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies and blockers, and escalate early to the Engineering Manager. Collaborate with product managers, architects, UX designers and QA to translate requirements into technical solutions. What Youll Bring: Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2–3 years as a Tech Lead or Solution Architect. Proven track record of leading agile teams that deliver enterprise SaaS products or platforms. Strong hands-on background in Java/Spring Boot and/or Python, with the ability to review full-stack code. Mandatory Skills: Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot and microservices architecture, with working knowledge of Python. Experience designing RESTful APIs, event-driven integrations and data models for distributed systems. Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, Docker and Kubernetes. Working knowledge of Angular and TypeScript, enough to review frontend designs and code. Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases. Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and release management. Exp. with Agile/Scrum, backlog refinement and estimation, using tools such as Jira & Confluence. Good understanding of secure coding, OAuth2/SSO and role-based access control (RBAC). Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Good to Have: Experience building connectors or integrations with SaaS, cloud or data platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Snowflake, Databricks). Exposure to GenAI/LLM-based applications and agentic AI frameworks. Domain knowledge of data privacy, data governance, security or AI governance products. Cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect or Azure Solutions Architect Expert. 
 Why join us? Build enterprise-grade products in data privacy, AI governance that are used worldwide. Work hands-on technologies across GenAI, agentic AI, cloud (AWS and Azure), full-stack engineering. Learn from experienced architects, engineering leaders through mentorship, design reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions. Grow your career with twice-yearly appraisals, certification support and a promote-from-within culture. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits as a full-time employee. Be part of an award-winning, CMMI Level 3 appraised data and AI company.

Key Skills: Angular,Typescript,Servicenow,SAAS,Architecture,Agile methodology,Rest,Enterprise
